finding: dof_limit_viol=30776 is a REAL policy behavior, NOT a config/metric bug — the env already correctly uses the tight X1 joint limits for both the reward penalty AND the action clamp. The violation rate (~5% of joint-instances) reflects the policy riding the conservative limits during swing/stabilization.

investigation.urdf_vs_x1_limits: URDF joint limits are ALL ±π (placeholder); X1_JOINT_LIMITS (tight, e.g. -0.90 to 0.70) are the real robot's conservative range.
investigation.env_already_correct: The env config (x1_dh_stand_config.py:60-68) ALREADY sets manual_joint_clip_lower/upper = X1_JOINT_LIMITS with comment 'exporter URDF limits are placeholders, use conservative locomotion windows'. _apply_manual_joint_limits (x1_dh_stand_env.py:119,124-135) is CALLED at init and sets self.dof_pos_limits to the tight values. _init_action_scaling (137-151) computes action_clip_low/high from these tight limits, and _compute_torques (line 398-399) APPLIES the clamp: actions = torch.clamp(actions, action_clip_low, action_clip_high). So both the reward penalty band AND the action clamp already use the correct tight limits.
investigation.conclusion: dof_viol=30776 is NOT a missing config or metric mismatch. The action IS clamped to the tight limits (with 0.95 safe_margin), yet dof_pos still exceeds them ~5% of the time. This is because the PD controller with the clamped target can still overshoot the joint position due to momentum/velocity at the sim step level (the clamp limits the target, not the physics integration). The policy has learned to use the full conservative range aggressively during swing.
investigation.violation_rate: 30776 violations / (20 episodes × 2401 steps × 12 joints = 576240 joint-instances) = 5.3%. The threshold is =0 (very strict for a learned walking policy).

fix_options_for_next_run.option_2_hard_termination: Add joint-limit violation to check_termination (end episode if any dof exceeds hard limit) — forces the policy to learn zero-violation behavior.
fix_options_for_next_run.option_3_physics_clamp: Edit the URDF limits to the tight range (resources/ is read-only in this workspace, so this requires a different checkout or a pre-launch script). This would make Isaac Gym hard-stop joints at the real limits.
fix_options_for_next_run.recommendation: Option 2 (hard termination) is the most direct path to dof_viol=0 and is a single-variable structural change.
